mods.name: Golden Grounds
mods.description: A comprehensive farming, mining, and trading economy mod. Grow crops, mine ores, trade with villagers — all from a sleek procedural UI powered by PocketUICore.

releases.notes:
## Golden Grounds v1.0.0
First release — farming, mining & trading mod for Minecraft 1.21.11

### Features
- **Farm Tab**: 6 plots, 8 crop types, seasonal growth, auto-water/replant upgrades
- **Mine Tab**: 4 shafts, 6 ore types, depth progression, auto-mine upgrades
- **Trade Tab**: 6 virtual villagers with 3 trades each, reputation system
- **Economy**: Gold currency, prestige system, upgrade shop (3 pages)
- **UI**: Full PocketUICore v1.9.0 dark-themed UI, controller/Controlify support, screen shake, haptic feedback
- **Persistence**: Per-world JSON save/load

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.141.3+1.21.11
- PocketUICore v1.9.0+
